elements.label: on-device processing, counts only
elements.quote: Each unit processes frames on the device and outputs counts only; no frame ever leaves the unit.

elements.label: overlap zone marked in each unit's pixel coordinates at install
elements.quote: At install time, the overlap zone is marked in each unit's own pixel coordinates.

elements.label: each unit reports total and overlap counts
elements.quote: Each unit reports two integers every 30 seconds: total people seen, and people seen inside the overlap zone.
terms: counting persons within the overlap region

elements.label: room = A + B - min(overlap_A, overlap_B)
elements.quote: The room aggregator computes room count = A + B - min(overlap_A, overlap_B).

elements.label: single-occupant rooms grouped in roll-ups
elements.quote: Above room level, counts roll up to floors, and any room with a single regular occupant is grouped with its neighbours so no one person is singled out.

problem.quote: Large rooms need two units with overlapping views. A person in the overlap is seen by both, and adding the counts double-counts. Sending both heat images to a server to merge them would move raw sensor data off the device.
